topSignals.title: Sixth consecutive quiet day — Elcogen now 18 days quiet, Topsoe 85 days.
topSignals.text: Dedicated searches for both priority stacks, this cycle's Tier 2 rotation round 3 (Kyocera, Aisin), the Tier 3 rotation cycle 11 round 2 (OxEon Energy, Nexceris, Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Miura, Weichai, Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol), every standing sweep query, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler (English and German), regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background or out-of-window items (see notes below). Nothing beat or neared any row in SOFC_Benchmark_Records.md. For Dominic: no action needed on the LCOE model today; SPP's own FERC large-load show-cause answer was due today (Nov 20), but no analyzable trade-press coverage of it has appeared yet — worth a follow-up check tomorrow.

items.text: Elcogen (priority): 18 days quiet (since the Nov 2 Hygreen Energy MoU). No new item found today. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory. A resurfaced Elcogen/China Southern Power Grid subsidiary pact and an Elcogen/Metrosert testing-expansion deal were both checked and confirmed to be already-logged September 2026 stories, not new.

Topsoe (priority): 85 days quiet on SOFC/SOEC specifically (since the Aug 27 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset). No new item found today; Topsoe's press feed remains active but non-solid-oxide (SOEC-for-PtX, ammonia, SAF).

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation (Kyocera, Aisin — round 3 of the current cycle): no new item for either. Kyocera's feed surfaced only a generic, dateless-KPI April 2026 marketing post on its SOFC stack technology; Aisin's background remained its standing (non-SOFC-specific) fuel-cell R&D history.

Tier 2 sweep ("Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra"): no new item; recycled Bloom's 2024-vintage 60% efficiency milestone and standing Amazon/Daroga Power background.

Tier 3 rotation — cycle 11, round 2 (OxEon Energy, Nexceris, Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Miura, Weichai, Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol), plus two cross-company sweeps: no new item for any; recycled standing DOE-project background (OxEon, Nexceris), Kawasaki's hydrogen-combustion (non-SOFC) gas-turbine work, Miura/Ceres's 4.2 kW CHP launch background, Weichai's Ceres-licensed stationary-power background, and Fraunhofer IKTS's standing SOC degradation-study program.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter, AEP/Google Cheyenne Fuel Cell LLC (702 MW/$4B, 20-yr PPA), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (28 MW, operational), NTT DATA (900 MW, global, shipments from 2027).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), Texas CRA (75 MW), SDCL (up to 450 MW). Also hosting the DOE/national-lab-backed StabilityMax R&D testbed in Danbury, CT. No named commercial deployment live yet.
Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B); supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
EGEN Energy (China, watch-list): Pre-commercial/early-stage; no named data-center customer yet.
